descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Paradise takes you to the tropics. Your hangar is a bright white glass hall by the sea, with palms and the lagoon right outside the windows and your three aircraft waiting inside.

AN ISLAND PARADISE
A Bahamas-style archipelago: a main island with an international airport and a pastel resort town, thirty little cays strung along a vast shallow sand bank, a deep blue hole, sandbars, and water that runs from white-sand shallows through aqua and turquoise to deep sapphire. Thousands of palms line the beaches.

SIX AIRPORTS
Citiview International, Palm Cay, Coral Key, Turtle Cay, Flamingo Cay - and Sand Dollar Cay, a short strip on a tiny island. Can you stop in time?

THREE AIRCRAFT
A business jet with a real glass cockpit and autopilot, a helicopter you can hover anywhere, and a fighter with a head-up display and afterburner.

YOUR HANGAR
Paint your aircraft any colour and finish, and power wash the grime off after every flight until they shine.

MISSIONS
Scored island landings, a sunset arrival at Sand Dollar Cay, the Reef Run low along the cays, the Resort Run down the palm boulevard, fighter missions and formation flying. Your logbook keeps your hours and pilot rank.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a 4-digit code. Join a friend's wing or ride in their right seat. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
